thread:
maria: Quick sync request  playground streaming UI. Key goals: clean stop/regenerate/continue flows, unobtrusive token indicator, prompt library that doesn't hijack focus. 20m?
noah: I'm in. Two quick asks: how visible should token count be for short chat responses? and where does the prompt panel live?
maria: Token count should be minimal for short replies: compact dot + small number on desktop, collapsed on mobile. Prompt panel = docked right sidesheet, not modal.
agnes: Accessibility: Stop must be keyboard accessible (Esc) and expose aria-live updates like "Generation paused, saved for 30 seconds." Provide keyboard shortcut hints in tooltips.
samir: Implementation note: Continue reuses server KV; Regenerate clears it. Propose default TTL 30s, configurable to 60s. Will check perf impact.
olivia: Copy suggestions: "Stop stream", "Continue stream", "Regenerate reply". Tooltip shortcuts: "Esc  Stop stream"; "Ctrl/Cmd+R  Regenerate".
uxbot: Sketch: [message] [pill: Streaming  12] [Stop] [Regenerate]
On stop -> [Saved  00:30] [Continue] [Regenerate]
noah: Mobile detail: collapse the pill to a single dot under 360px. Tap expands to controls. Ensure reduced-motion option.
agnes: Also provide a visible countdown text for SR users, and color is not the only affordance. Contrast AA required.
maria: Decisions: show live-only token count while streaming, final total after completion, TTL default 30s, prompt sidesheet docked. Action items: Noah  mock desktop+mobile variants, Agnes  write aria snippets and keyboard map, Samir  perf numbers for 30/60s, Olivia  bundle copy strings. Reconvene ~48h.
noah: Will post mocks to #design-assets.
